LightningComponentBundle.description: B2B / B2C - Configurable list of Data Cloud / marketing segments, rendered as badges. The card title auto-appends the segment count.

property.name: language
property.label: UI language
property.description: Two-letter code - 'en' (default) or 'fr'. Controls the default card title and default segment list. Explicit values on cardTitle / segmentsCsv still override the dictionary.

property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Card title (override)
property.description: Leave empty to use the dictionary default (‘Active Segments’ / ‘Segments actifs’). Shown as '<title> (N)'.

property.name: segmentsCsv
property.label: Segments (comma-separated) (override)
property.description: Leave empty for the language-appropriate default list. Each item becomes a badge.

property.name: colorMode
property.label: Color mode
property.description: 'random' (default) = each tag gets a soft pastel from a curated palette. 'custom' = use the customColorsCsv list. 'single' = every tag uses the singleColor value.

property.name: customColorsCsv
property.label: Custom colors (hex CSV, for 'custom' mode)
property.description: Comma-separated hex colors, one per segment. Shorter lists cycle. Ignored unless colorMode = custom.

property.name: singleColor
property.label: Single color (hex, for 'single' mode)
property.description: Applied to every tag when colorMode = single. Defaults to the SLDS-style light grey.
